title: GLM-5.3-Flash agent builds navigable Blender dream kitchen world
summary: Lou claims GLM-5.3-Flash built a navigable dream-kitchen 3D world inside Blender and stresses the result is not a generated video. Example of agent-driven interior blockout rather than a BESS marketing site.
question_it_answers: What does an agent-built Blender interior look like when it is a 3D world rather than a video model output?

claims.text: Author states GLM-5.3-Flash built a 3D kitchen world in Blender.
claims.evidence: We use GLM-5.3-Flash build a dream kitchen. A 3D world built in Blender.
claims.subject: blockout-to-video-flythrough

claims.text: Author explicitly distinguishes the capture from a generated video.
claims.evidence: This is not a generated video.
claims.subject: blockout-to-video-flythrough

claims.text: Official GLM-5.3-Flash docs (docs.z.ai/guides/vlm/glm-5.3-flash, 200 / 333,788 B) name it the first native multimodal GLM-5 model: 320B total / 18B activated, 1M context / 128K output, API code glm-5.3-flash. Visual coding loop explicitly includes Blender 3D scenes; a best-practice recipe is “From a Single Description to a Complete Blender Project” with ≥4 build→fixed-camera-render→inspect rounds and a .blend delivery. HF zai-org/GLM-5.3-Flash is MIT, 2,053 likes / 654,957 downloads, arXiv 2602.15763 (paper title GLM-5: from Vibe Coding to Agentic Engineering, v2 2026-02-24). chat.z.ai title is powered by GLM-5.3-Flash. Kitchen-specific “dream kitchen” copy stays tweet-only. zai-org GitHub search for GLM-5.3 returned 0 official repos this pass (weights on HF).
